scope: Read-only independent chemical grounding assistance; no maintained graph or source edits.

chebi_query.sql: SELECT value FROM statements WHERE subject = CHEBI:57310 AND predicate = chemrof:inchi_string
chebi_query.limitation: Selected original database row queried here. Full database was previously hashed by cohort integration; no new whole-database hash is claimed by this narrow check.

exact_comparison.chebi_vs_ps7: Identical standard InChI after removing the protonation layer and changing /m0 to /m1; /t28-,29-,30- and /s1 are unchanged.
exact_comparison.native_vs_chebi: Same standard InChI except the parity sign of canonical tetrahedral center 30 differs.

interpretation.method: Official InChI stereochemical layer semantics, not conversion of +/- signs to CIP R/S names.
interpretation.finding: The ChEBI and PS7 encodings are mirror-related at their fixed absolute tetrahedral configurations; protonation does not explain the distinction. Native CPD-465 is also not an identical stereochemical encoding.
not_claimed: Which source structure is the chemically correct physiological PSPP
That either a common name or the RRR synonym resolves the disagreement
That a ligand dictionary entry alone proves the Newman-produced intermediate absolute configuration

primary_assessment.locator: Main paper, printed p.21342 (PDF page 6), Methods
primary_assessment.assessment: The PSPP substrate was synthesized using human squalene synthase, purified by C8 chromatography and assessed by LC-MS/MS. CrtM crystals were supplied with PSPP. This experimental provenance is not direct isolation and absolute stereochemical analysis of Newman-produced PSPP.

primary_assessment.locator: Main paper, printed pp.21338-21339; Figure 2; supporting Figure S2 and Table S1
primary_assessment.assessment: Mutant and wild-type structures support PSPP binding and the two-half-reaction mechanism. The reported similarity of ligand poses does not reconcile the conflicting external InChI encodings.

primary_assessment.locator: Supporting Information page 1, Expression and X-ray Crystallography
primary_assessment.assessment: CrtM was expressed in E. coli BL21 and structures were modeled/refined with molecular replacement and ligand-modeling tools. BL21 is the expression host, not the natural pathway taxon.

strain_scope.limitation: This source is distinct from the Newman strain target; a separate exact bridge is required for Newman-specific assertions.

disposition: The unresolved exact chemical grounding conflict is supported. Retain whole-route research and source-specific structures; do not silently substitute PS7 or CPD-465, and do not treat reaction balance or matching names as stereochemical validation.
